text:
Type: white tabletop picture frame on a stand
Use: displaying two photos back to back on a desk, shelf or table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: glossy white plastic frame and base, clear plastic front
Colors: white
Shape: upright rectangular frame with a slim border, short round stem and disc foot, shows a picture on each side, compact and light
Feel: clean, simple, light, cheerful
Goes with: white desks, light wood shelves, colorful photos, any palette; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: TOLSBY
product.description: You can display one picture on each side as the frame has no back panel.
